reasoning_traces.think:
The three primitives form a coherent risk-reduction system: Launch Readiness Score (R) quantifies the probability of successful deployment, UI Implementation State (S) provides empirical grounding for R, and Risk Reduction Factor (F_r) encapsulates the cost-benefit trade-off of UX integrity. When S=0, R cannot be computed reliably, triggering F_r to diverge. This creates a dual failure mode: one in which the system lacks evidence (S), and another in which it fails to meet safety thresholds (R < threshold). These primitives enable GSI to model launch outcomes as a Bayesian process and GSE to simulate state transitions through build queues and blocker resolution.
